input.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity with procedure and Section 20.5 remedies, and narrow Customer's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently contains only a broad Customer indemnity and no Vendor indemnity, and Section 9.3 already cross-references remedies in Section 20.5 that do not exist. We have added a Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused compromise of Customer Data and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, together with standard indemnification procedure and infringement remedies, and narrowed Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) content or materials Customer provides to Vendor for use in the Services, or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim (delay does not excuse the indemnity except to the extent it materially prejudices the defence), permit the indemnifying Party to control the defence with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense. The indemnified Party may participate with its own counsel at its own cost. The indemnifying Party shall not settle a claim in a way that imposes a non-indemnified obligation or admission on the indemnified Party without its prior written consent.

Vendor's obligation under Section 20.2(a) does not apply to the extent the claim arises from Customer's modification of a Deliverable without Vendor's involvement, combination of the Services with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not have arisen but for the combination, or Vendor's compliance with detailed written specifications supplied by Customer.

If an infringement claim is made or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall, at its expense and at Customer's option, procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent, non-infringing item. If neither remedy is reasonably available, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverables and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees allocable to the terminated items and Fees paid for Deliverables Customer can no longer use. These remedies do not limit Vendor's indemnity under Section 20.2.
